info.name: SongNhat Support Resolution Copilot — QA Collection
info.description:
API test collection for QA. Run in order: Health Check -> Auth -> Tickets -> Copilot.

Instructions:
1. Select Environment 'SongNhat Copilot - Local Dev'
2. Run 'POST /api/auth/login' first — token is saved automatically
3. All subsequent requests use the saved token

exec: pm.test('[TC-00] Status 200 OK - Backend is online', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-00b] Response contains running message', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.message).to.include('running'); });
pm.test('[TC-01] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('[TC-02] Returns bearer access_token', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.token_type).to.eql('bearer'); pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', body.access_token); });

request.description: Run this first. Token auto-saved to accessToken variable.

exec: pm.test('[TC-03] Status 401 Unauthorized on wrong password', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('[TC-04] Returns error detail message', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.detail).to.be.a('string'); });
pm.test('[TC-05] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-06] Returns user profile with required fields', () => { const u = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(u).to.have.keys('id', 'email', 'role', 'full_name'); });
pm.test('[TC-07] Status 401 when no token provided', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('[TC-08] Status 201 Created', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('[TC-09] Returns created ticket with ID', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data).to.exist; if (body.data && body.data.id) { pm.collectionVariables.set('ticketId', body.data.id); } });
pm.test('[TC-10] Status 201 Created', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));
pm.test('[TC-11] Hazard ticket is created', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.exist; });
pm.test('[TC-12] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-13] Returns paginated structure', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.any.keys('items', 'tickets', 'data'); });
pm.test('[TC-14] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('[TC-15] All returned tickets match status filter', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); const items = body.items ?? body.tickets ?? body.data ?? []; items.forEach(t => pm.expect(t.status.toLowerCase()).to.eql('open')); });
pm.test('[TC-16] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-17] Returns ticket id and title', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.have.any.keys('id', 'title'); });

request.description: Run Create Ticket first to populate ticketId.

exec: pm.test('[TC-18] Status 404 Not Found', () => pm.response.to.have.status(404));
pm.test('[TC-19] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-20] Ticket status changes to resolved', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data?.status ?? body.status).to.match(/resolved/i); });

item.name: Copilot AI Engine
item.description: AI analysis and safety check endpoints — available after CRM-28 Sprint 3

exec: pm.test('[TC-21] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

pm.test('[TC-22] Returns complete CopilotPackage', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.is_hazard_escalated).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.draft_reply).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('[TC-23] Status 200 OK', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('[TC-24] is_hazard_escalated is TRUE', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().is_hazard_escalated).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('[TC-25] No draft_reply returned on hazard', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().draft_reply ?? '').to.be.empty; });
